title: Terms & Conditions
body:
Terms & Conditions.

## 2. About Our Services

 This website provides information about plastic surgery procedures, consultation coordination, recovery support, and international patient guidance for individuals interested in care with Dr. Fulvio Correa in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia.

## 3. No Doctor-Patient Relationship Through the Website

 Using this website, submitting information, sending photos, or exchanging messages with our team does not create a doctor-patient relationship. A doctor-patient relationship is created only after a formal medical consultation and acceptance by the medical provider.

## 4. Consultation and Candidacy

 All procedures require medical evaluation. Not every person is a candidate for surgery. Final recommendations depend on your health history, anatomy, expectations, laboratory studies, in-person or virtual evaluation, and the surgeon’s medical judgment.

## 5. Results and Testimonials

 Before-and-after photos, testimonials, and patient stories are examples of individual experiences. Results vary from patient to patient and are not guaranteed.

## 6. Risks of Surgery

 All surgical procedures involve risks, including but not limited to infection, bleeding, scarring, anesthesia-related complications, delayed healing, dissatisfaction with results, and the possibility of revision surgery.

## 7. International Travel and Recovery

 Patients traveling to Colombia are responsible for valid travel documents, flight arrangements, and appropriate recovery planning unless otherwise specified in a confirmed package.

## 8. Payments, Fees, and Cancellations

 Consultation fees, procedure quotes, payment schedules, refunds, and cancellation policies may vary depending on the treatment plan and are communicated separately by our team.

## 9. Website Content

 We make reasonable efforts to keep information accurate and current, but we do not guarantee that all content is complete, updated, or free from errors.

## 10. User Responsibilities

 You agree to provide truthful and accurate information and not misuse the website or communication systems.

## 11. Third-Party Platforms

 Our website may include forms, maps, embedded videos, analytics tools, chat widgets, CRM systems, WhatsApp integrations, and third-party communication technologies.

## 12. SMS and Electronic Communications

 By submitting your contact information and opting into communications, you agree to receive SMS, WhatsApp, and email communications related to your inquiry, scheduling, consultations, or requested information.

 Message and data rates may apply. Reply **STOP** to unsubscribe or **HELP** for assistance.

## 13. Intellectual Property

 All website content, including text, design, branding, graphics, photos, videos, and layout, is owned by or licensed to Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery and may not be copied or reproduced without written authorization.

## 14. Limitation of Liability

 Fulvio Correa Plastic Surgery is not liable for damages arising from misuse of this website, reliance on website information, third-party platform failures, or unauthorized use of communication systems.

## 15. Governing Law

 These Terms are governed by the applicable laws of Colombia, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection rules that may apply in your country of residence.

## 16. Contact

 For questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, contact our patient support team directly through our official communication channels.
